kmc_output_definitions.time_ps: kMC time of the trajectory in ps (attempt frequency nu = 1 THz)
kmc_output_definitions.vacancy_r2_a2: squared net displacement of the vacancy over the trajectory, in units of a^2 (a = cubic lattice parameter)
kmc_output_definitions.sum_r2_a2: sum over all atoms of each element of the squared net displacement, a^2
kmc_output_definitions.hops: number of vacancy exchanges performed by atoms of each element
kmc_output_definitions.mean_encountered_barrier_eV: mean barrier of all 8 candidate hops, averaged over steps
kmc_output_definitions.mean_accepted_barrier_eV: mean barrier of the hops performed
kmc_output_definitions.equilibration_acceptance: acceptance ratio of the equilibration swaps
kmc_output_definitions.checkpoints: optional intermediate (step, time_ps, vacancy_r2_a2, sum_r2_a2) records
kmc_output_definitions.nn_pair_counts_after_equilibration: ordered nearest-neighbour pair counts between elements, summed over trajectories, right after equilibration (before the kMC hops)
